verification_policy: Every linked byte comes from a recovered or candidate source object; every function of the natural interval is linked in original address order (canonical members are regression checks); unknown gaps and unlinked outside spans remain unclaimed; gap-crossing PC-relative references are accepted only when their displacement class is gap-independent

natural_interval.gap_policy: A PC-relative reference crossing a compaction span is compared by target identity only when its original and compact displacement classes agree; otherwise the unit is BLOCKED (GAP_DEPENDENT_ENCODING). No span byte is claimed.
